name: bundled-stateful-session-store
description: Controlled multi-session-state robustness research on the project-owned session store; no external target is contacted.

failure_policy.rejected: explicit malformed/state-invalid rejection, not a finding
failure_policy.crash: group by exception type, defect location and required session state path; reduce while preserving state build-up, defect location and key interaction bytes
failure_policy.timeout: separate timing finding; record the interaction in flight and every replay attempt
failure_policy.runner_error: process abort/crash in a dedicated fresh worker; the next sequence starts from a clean session
